edition: OOXML WordprocessingML (.docx) via python-docx 1.2.0; legacy .doc and macro-enabled .docm are rejected

operations.name: parse
operations.description: Extract body paragraphs and table cells as fragments with paragraph/table/row/column anchors

limitations: Headers, footers, footnotes, endnotes, comments, text boxes, SmartArt and images are not extracted; documents with images or text boxes are marked incomplete
No OCR; no layout or formatting fidelity; styles are reported by name only
Tracked changes: inserted text is included, deleted text is excluded, as python-docx reads the document body
Fixtures are generated with python-docx; files authored in Microsoft Word are still needed for sandbox-level verification
